query: While optimizing the network's hyperparameters, we found that learning rate updating algorithm proposed by default in the KNIME architecture, as well as in Krizhevsky et al. - Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with Nesterov momentum - was failing to converge on our fluorescence microscopy data (Krizhevsky et al., 2012).
